title: Church leaders: The Wisdom Gap & the Conditions for Trust
description: Church leaders  Redesign the game board, not the players.
content:
## Church leaders

Redesign the game board, not the players. Treat communication as a whole-body discipline with a clear path for anyone to create, review, and publish a story — not one minister's job. Give small groups real platform support for discoverability, scheduling, and invitation. Treat transition times between services and classes as key invitational moments — extend them, extend children's pick-up, release kids to the playground. Prioritize high-quality communal meals that make staying easy and childcare flexible. Each of these is one of the three trust conditions made concrete. *(The institutional-standards material — exceeding legal minimums on misconduct, tax, and equity — now lives in Module 7 as binding scale to responsibility.)*
